title: Brčko District Assembly presents first draft information security law at public debate
date_note: The page gives the public debate as Tuesday 24 November; no earlier day.
geo_basis: Brčko District Assembly, where the draft law was presented
summary: The Brčko District Assembly's Speaker, Damir Bulčević, said the draft law on information security, presented at a public debate on 24 November, matters because of cyber attacks on District institutions in recent years, and he expects adoption by the end of December. According to the Assembly's statement, it would be the District's first such law, create an information security service and a CSIRT within the District Police, and incorporate key provisions of the EU's NIS 2 Directive.
plain: Brčko District has a draft law on information security. The Assembly's Speaker expects it to be adopted by the end of December.
exec: Brčko District's Assembly is moving a first information security law, with NIS 2 provisions, that Speaker Bulčević expects adopted by the end of December.

validation.note: One publisher (Oslobođenje, credited to Fena) relaying the Assembly's statement and speakers' remarks.
